metas.name: Indian Penal Law
metas.description: Gunasekaran drives his own car. Anbu and Kanimozhi fall in love. In order to prevent the Chief Ministers video from getting out, Chief Minister Assistant and Inspector Muthu Karupan kills a young man. They put the blame on Gunasekar. This story is about how Anbu saves Gunasekaran from this.

metas.name: Innocent HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Inspector Zende
metas.description: When serial killer Carl Bhojraj escapes prison and resurfaces in Mumbai, the determined Inspector Zende steps up to nab the cunning fugitive once more.

metas.name: Invincible Swordsman
metas.description: Linghu Chong, a swordsman longing to leave the martial arts world, is drawn back into the clash between good and evil. On his journey, he unexpectedly crosses paths with Dongfang Bubai, the enigmatic leader of the Demonic Sect, leading to an unpredictable and tumultuous adventure through the martial arts realm.

metas.name: It Was Just An Accident
metas.description: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.

metas.name: Jaat
metas.description: A mysterious stranger journeys to a remote town controlled by a callous crime lord, with one violent mission — restoring justice to its people.

metas.name: Jack
metas.description: Jack, an aspiring but overeager intelligence agent, goes against protocol and the real spies, to foil a potential attack on home turf.

metas.name: Jatadhara
metas.description: Shiva, a rational ghost hunter, man of science and reason—is drawn back to the mystery of a powerful guardian spirit named Dhanapisachi, pulled into a world where his beliefs are tested.

metas.name: Jewel Thief: The Heist Begins
metas.description: In this high-octane battle of wits and wills, ingenious con artist Rehan devises a diamond heist while trying to outsmart Rajan, his sadistic adversary.

metas.name: Jhor HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Jigris
metas.description: The story revolves around four friends embarking on an unexpected road trip in a rusty Maruti 800.

metas.name: Jija Sala Jija
metas.description: Family relationships get hilariously complicated when three connected brothers-in-law find themselves in increasingly absurd situations.

metas.name: Jilabi
metas.description: Corrupt Inspector Vijay Karamarkar takes charge of a wealthy industrialist's murder case, seeing it as a chance to profit. However, he soon finds himself entangled in deeper troubles, complicating his life further.

metas.name: Jolly LLB 3
metas.description: The third part of the Jolly LLB trilogy brings back Jagdish Tyagi and Jagdishwar Mishra for the biggest face-off as penurious widow Janki Devi Solanki awaits justice against business tycoon Haribhai Khaitan in a satire on the judiciary, justice and the gulf between the privileged and the people on the other side of the spectrum.

metas.name: Jora Kaiya Thattunga
metas.description: A solitary magician in rural South India battles social resistance while pursuing his deceased father's aspirations, until hardship sparks his metamorphosis into a resilient force ready to overcome.

metas.name: JSK Janaki V vs State of Kerala
metas.description: Janaki, an IT professional from Bangalore, returns to her hometown in Kerala for a quiet vacation. But her peace is shattered when she becomes the victim of a horrific incident. As she begins her fight for justice, the case takes an unexpected turn with the entry of Advocate David Abel Donovan.

metas.name: K O
metas.description: A former fighter must find the missing son of an opponent he accidentally killed years ago, taking on a brutally violent crime gang in Marseille.

metas.name: Kaal Trighori HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Kaalidhar Laapata
metas.description: An ageing Kaalidhar escapes his family after overhearing their plans to abandon him. He meets the free-spirited Ballu, and they embark on an adventure to tick things off Kaalidhar's bucket list.

metas.name: Kaantha
metas.description: Set in the backdrop of a film set, in the 1950’s in post colonial Madras, the film is centred around the professional rivalry between a film-maker trying to make his seminal film and the top reigning actor who the director once introduced. The rivalry spirals around the leading actress, a debutante and as the relationship between the three.

metas.name: Kadhalikka Neramillai
metas.description: Does the idea of a perfect life leading to love, marriage and babies exist? Shriya finds it a challenge, especially when she meets men like Siddarth who think marriage is a recipe for disaster, and babies should be banned. When times are changing and relationships are evolving, the idea of love remains timeless- the more you resist it the more you will fall in love.

metas.name: KalamKaval
metas.description: Early 2010s. A routine Kerala Police inquiry in the quiet village of Kottayikonam takes an unexpected turn when a trail of seemingly minor clues unravels into a string of disturbing cases. The investigation soon crosses into Tamil Nadu, revealing unsolved mysteries that have lingered for years.

metas.name: Kaliyugam 2064
metas.description: Set in the dystopian future,  2064 AD, the apocalyptic world is stripped of food, water, and humanity. In a ruthless fight for survival, the few remaining must navigate chaos, danger, and the depths of human desperation.

metas.name: Kannappa
metas.description: After witnessing the cruel sacrifice of his childhood friend, an atheist warrior rejects religion until love forces him to find his own faith.

metas.name: Kantara A Legend Chapter 1
metas.description: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

metas.name: Kantara Chapter 1
metas.description: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

metas.name: Karamsutra
metas.description: It is a revenge thriller where a simple small town girl moves to the big city chasing dreams but is betrayed, assaulted, and left broken. Her pain sparks a deadly revenge tale, as a cop races to stop a killer targeting lustful men.

metas.name: Karate Kid Legends
metas.description: After a family tragedy, kung fu prodigy Li Fong is uprooted from his home in Beijing and forced to move to New York City with his mother. When a new friend needs his help, Li enters a karate competition – but his skills alone aren't enough. Li's kung fu teacher Mr. Han enlists original Karate Kid Daniel LaRusso for help, and Li learns a new way to fight, merging their two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

metas.name: Kaushaljis VS Kaushal
metas.description: Yug Kaushal, a 27-year-old, leaves behind his small-town roots in Kannauj and moves to Delhi. Always cribbing about his parent not adapting to the modern lifestyle and more urban way of living their life, Yug gets the shock of his life when the senior Kaushals consider mutual separation as the situation spirals into chaos.

metas.name: Kesari Chapter 2: The Untold Story of Jallianwala Bagh
metas.description: A dramatization of the life story of C. Sankaran Nair, the lawyer who fought for the truth behind the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

metas.name: Kesari Veer
metas.description: The movie narrates the tale of Hamirji Gohil, a brave warrior who fought against the Tughlaq Empire to protect the Somnath Temple and the Hindu faith.

metas.name: Khalnigranaaya HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Killbill Society
metas.description: As Ananda Kar returns, now as Mrityunjay Kar, truth and destiny collide in a journey of love, healing, and purpose. With its iconic music and unexpected twists, Killbill Society is set to redefine `existence` through its compelling story.

metas.name: Kingdom
metas.description: Set on an island off the coast of New England in the summer of 1965, Moonrise Kingdom tells the story of two twelve-year-olds who fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As various authorities try to hunt them down, a violent storm is brewing off-shore – and the peaceful island community is turned upside down in more ways than anyone can handle.

metas.name: Kirtaner Por Kirtan
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2
metas.description: Mohan wants to marry the love of his life, Sania, but destiny has a madcap plan! He ends up marrying three women of different religions and chaos follows.

metas.name: Kishkindhapuri
metas.description: A ghost walking tour group visits an abandoned radio station, inadvertently awakening a vengeful spirit.

metas.name: Kothalavadi
metas.description: In the famine-stricken village of Kothalavadi, greed sparks chaos as a ruthless scrap dealer manipulates desperate villagers into illegal sand mining, using them as pawns in his quest for power. When tragedy strikes and blood is spilt, an iron-willed officer, a betrayed enforcer, and a cunning politician clash for control. As tensions rise, the villagers must choose: break free or be consumed by their greed.

metas.name: KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.

metas.name: Kuberaa
metas.description: A ruthless billionaire, Neeraj, uses beggars as benamis to launder money, with the help of a disgraced civil submit servant, Deepak. One of the beggars, Deva, escapes with ₹10,000 crores and becomes the target of a deadly manhunt. He meets Sameera, who joins him in his mission to use the money to uplift society's poor. With Deepak's help, Deva fights back.

metas.name: Kudumbasthan
metas.description: Naveen's relationship with his parents becomes strained after he marries a oppressed-caste girl. Though they eventually reconcile, his sudden unemployment puts him in a difficult position. As financial pressures mount, Naveen must navigate societal challenges and personal struggles to regain stability and rebuild harmony within his middle-class family.

metas.name: L2 Empuraan
metas.description: Five years after becoming Chief Minister of Kerala, Jathin Ramdas' move to align with communal forces led by Balraj 'Baba' Bajrangi, triggers Stephen Nedumpally aka Khureshi Ab'raam to return with his Man Friday Zayed Masood to save his home state and settle scores.

metas.name: Laalo Krishna Sada Sahaayate
metas.description: A rickshaw driver trapped in a farmhouse confronts his past demons while experiencing visions of Lord Krishna, who guides him through a transformative journey of self-discovery and healing.

metas.name: Last Bullet
metas.description: Car genius Lino returns to conclude his vendetta against Areski and the corrupt commander who ruined their lives in this turbo-charged trilogy finale.

metas.name: Lawho Gouranger Naam Rey
metas.description: Lawho Gouranger Naam Rey intertwines three timelines from Mahaprabhu's divine era to colonial theatre and a modern film set.

metas.name: Light Of The World
metas.description: It's 30 AD and everyone is expectantly awaiting the coming Messiah. While Jesus isn't exactly what they imagined, there is something special about this man. Soon, John, James, Andrew, Peter, and others begin to follow Jesus on an unexpected adventure. This beautifully animated story of Jesus is told through the eyes of his beloved young friend, the Apostle John.

metas.name: Little Hearts
metas.description: Akhil, when failed in EAMCET exam, is forced into long-term coaching after heartbreak teaches him the difference between true and shallow love. At the center, he meets Katyayani and falls for her, only to be rejected for a strange reason. Determined not to lose her, his humorous and transformative journey to win her heart becomes the soul of the story.

metas.name: Logout
metas.description: Pratyush, a social media influencer who is about to reach his biggest milestone in terms of followers to land a deal with a brand, loses his phone to a fan obsessed with him. Trapped in his own house without his phone, Pratyush must find a way to reclaim his identity and his career.

metas.name: Lokah Chapter One Chandra
metas.description: The story follows Chandra, a mysterious, goth-influenced woman who has just moved to Bangalore and begins working night shifts at a café. Across the road from her apartment live Sunny and Venu, two aimless bachelors. Sunny becomes infatuated with Chandra, observing her odd routines, strange visitors, and reclusive nature. Their dynamic changes when Sunny gets a glimpse of Chandra in her act.

metas.name: Love in Vietnam
metas.description: A passionate cross-cultural romance unfolds between Vietnam and Punjab, inspired by the classic Turkish novel 'Madonna in a Fur Coat.

metas.name: Love Karu Yaaa Shaadi
metas.description: Rahul, a 27-year-old MBA from Kanpur, finds himself torn between societal pressure and personal desire when he falls for Priya, a strong-willed MNC professional from Lucknow. While his spiritualist mother pushes for an arranged marriage, Rahul`s friend Raj urges him to enjoy life without commitment. As love blossoms between Rahul and Priya, conflicting beliefs about relationships spark tension. When a misunderstanding threatens to pull them apart, Rahul must confront his feelings, grow up, and choose between fleeting freedom and lasting love.

metas.name: Love U Muddu
metas.description: Love you Muddu is a Romantic drama film starring Siddu N, Rajesh Nataranga and reshmaa L.

metas.name: Love Untangled
metas.description: A lovestruck teen plans to win the school heartthrob by going from curly to straight hair — until a new transfer student changes everything.

metas.name: Lovedale
metas.description: Isha, an air hostess and model, joins photographer Ruben for a shoot at his iconic spot, Lovedale. A night in a remote forest bungalow takes a terrifying turn as unexpected dangers arise. Will they survive the horrors that await?

metas.name: Maa
metas.description: A mother and daughter encounter a demon in a village where girls have been disappearing.

metas.name: Maadeva
metas.description: A stoic villager named Maadeva falls for Parvathi, discovering emotions and human bonds. As he opens his heart to life and relationships, conflicts with rival families test his newfound understanding.

metas.name: Maalik
metas.description: Set in the rural, rusty and politically charged Allahabad of the 1980s, Maalik is a peek into the making of a dreaded gangster from a humble background with intoxication of power to rule the world.

metas.name: Maaman
metas.description: An uncle's deep connection with his nephew is broken, when their family experiences personal differences.

metas.name: Maareesan
metas.description: A petty thief embarks on a road trip with an elderly man suffering from memory loss under deceptive pretenses. As they journey across Tamil Nadu, the promise of an easy con unravels into a quietly shifting connection, with both men hiding secrets of their own.

metas.name: Maargan
metas.description: ADGP Dhruv, a seasoned high-ranking police officer haunted by a tragic past, grapples with a labyrinthine case, where every clue unearths a darker secret. As he uncovers clues linking to a mysterious swimmer, he races against time to stop a cunning serial killer driven by dark secrets.

metas.name: Mad Square
metas.description: After his wedding turns into a disaster, Laddu and his pals — Manoj, Ashok and Damodar — find themselves traveling to Goa for another wild adventure.

metas.name: Madam Sengupta
metas.description: A famed cartoonist's search for her daughter's killer unravels a sinister trail of poetic murders, leading back to her estranged ex-husband, whose forbidden play threatens to expose Kolkata's darkest secrets.

metas.name: Madhaniyan
metas.description: Family tensions arise after a brother disapproves of his sister's boyfriend's family.

metas.name: Madharaasi
metas.description: A man with a psychological disorder overcomes trauma and confronts his nemesis in a fast-paced action film with romance and unique elements, exploring themes of resilience and redemption.

metas.name: Madraskaaran
metas.description: A minor argument between two strangers escalates into a life-altering conflict, exploring how a seemingly insignificant event can drastically alter a person's perception and circumstances.

metas.name: Mahasenha
metas.description: Mahasenha is a mythological jungle thriller set in the mystichills of Kurangani, where an ancient Yaali sculpture, worshipped by the tribal villagers as a divine protector, becomes the center of a high-stakes conflict. The film delivers a powerful message : Faith is not just belief-its protection.

metas.name: Mahavatar Narsimha
metas.description: Tyrannical demon Hiranyakashyap challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

metas.name: Mamta Child Factory
metas.description: Two small-town real estate agents help a city doctor establish a surrogacy hospital, battling local prejudices and traditional mindsets in their conservative community.

metas.name: Manada Kadalu
metas.description: "Manada Kadalu" is a coming-of-age love story. Sumukha, an MBBS dropout, pursues love interest Rashika. However, friend Anjali's influence leads him to self-discovery and reevaluating life's value.

metas.name: Mannu Kya Karegga HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Maranamass
metas.description: An unlikely group of people become trapped on a bus with a man they do not realise is the serial killer terrorising their community.

metas.name: Mario
metas.description: While working underground to fix a water main, Brooklyn plumbers—and brothers—Mario and Luigi are transported down a mysterious pipe and wander into a magical new world. But when the brothers are separated, Mario embarks on an epic quest to find Luigi.

metas.name: Mark
metas.description: Mark is suspended from his police duties for his unruly yet effective ways of operating, but when 18 children are abducted and found dead, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.

metas.name: Mass Jathara
metas.description: A transport officer battles a violent drug lord and his criminal clan.

metas.name: Mastiii 4
metas.description: Three frustrated husbands seek freedom from their dull marriages. A wild idea promises escape and excitement. But what follows is anything but expected.

metas.name: Match Fixing
metas.description: A secret war was hatched. A fake narrative took shape. A nation was deceived. Unveil a shocking conspiracy that shook the country.

metas.name: Mayasabha HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Me No Pause Me Play
metas.description: Me No Pause Me Play is a heartwarming and empowering story of women navigating life's transitions, rediscovering their strength, and redefining identity beyond age, delivering a powerful message of awareness and acceptance around menopause.

metas.name: Mere Husband Ki Biwi
metas.description: A Delhi professional faces a love triangle when his old flame returns as he falls for someone new. This leads to a series of comedic misunderstandings in his relationships.

metas.name: Metro In Dino
metas.description: Follows interconnected stories of several different couples, each facing a crossroads at different stages in their lives and relationships.

metas.name: Mirage
metas.description: A woman joins forces with a journalist to investigate secrets her fiancé was keeping from her after she is informed he has died in a tragic train accident.

metas.name: Mirai
metas.description: Four-year-old Kun struggles with jealousy after his newborn sister, Mirai, begins receiving most of his family’s attention. Retreating to the garden, he encounters Mirai as a teenager from the future and embarks on extraordinary journeys across his family’s past, gradually discovering new perspectives on love, belonging and what it means to become an older brother.

metas.name: Missing Face
metas.description: Aryan suffers from a rare neurological disorder, face blindness, that prevents him from recognizing faces, even of those closest to him. Six months after his younger brother Rohan mysteriously disappears, Aryan receives an urgent SOS call from him. The last time Aryan saw Rohan was during a campfire night with friends, where Aryan witnessed someone being thrown off a cliffbut due to his condition, he couldnt identify the victim or the perpetrators. When Aryan reports this to the police, hes stunned to learn that every person present at the campfire is still alive. So, who died that night? And who is now threatening Rohan?

metas.name: Mithada Maheman
metas.description: Distraught Aditya finds himself on a road trip with three strangers who offer different perspectives on his life.

metas.name: Mithra Mandali
metas.description: The lives of a group of misfit friends become chaotic after one of them falls for a politician's daughter.

metas.name: Mokshapatam
metas.description: Mokshapatam Gayatri is a middle-class woman working as a floor manager at a hotel. She has dreams of giving a better life to her kid and making a decent living with her savings until her family loses money to her husband's friend, who dies in an accident. On a fateful day, she discovers a bag forgotten by a customer in the hotel room. Will this bag change her fate or throw her into more problems? Watch now!

metas.name: Moonwalk
metas.description: It's the year 1987. Youngsters living in the outskirts of Thiruvananthapuram start exploring breakdancing.

metas.name: Mrigaya The Hunt
metas.description: The gruesome death of a sex worker at Kolkata's Sonagachi brings four very unlikely cops together for the inquiry. What follows is a hunt for the criminal, where the lines between good and evil blur.

metas.name: Mudborn
metas.description: Hsu-Chuan, who works at a game company, accidentally brings home a broken clay doll from a haunted house while developing a new horror VR game. Unexpectedly, his pregnant wife, Mu-Hua, a cultural relic restorer, develops an obsession with the doll and relentlessly tries to repair it. As strange things begin to happen in the house, Mu-Hua's condition deteriorates, and Hsu-Chuan, at his wits' end, seeks help from a spiritual medium, Ah-Sheng. Meanwhile, the horrifying secret hidden behind the clay doll begins to surface.

metas.name: Murderbaad
metas.description: A Jaipur tour guide's romance with an NRI unravels when a fellow tourist goes missing. As suspicion mounts, he vanishes-sparking a nationwide hunt that leads to one of modern India's most shocking crime twists.

metas.name: Nadaaniyan
metas.description: A privileged Delhi socialite hires a middle-class student to pose as her boyfriend to maintain her social status. Their pretense becomes complicated when genuine feelings develop between them.

metas.name: Nafratein HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: Bollywood

metas.name: Narivetta
metas.description: A police officer uncovers a conspiracy based around state-sanctioned violence against victimized villagers.

metas.name: Ne Zha 2
metas.description: After a catastrophic event leaves their bodies destroyed, Ne Zha and Ao Bing are granted a fragile second chance at life. As tensions rise between the dragon clans and celestial forces, the two must undergo a series of perilous trials that will test their bond, challenge their identities, and decide the fate of both mortals and immortals.

metas.name: Nikita Roy
metas.description: A woman's scepticism about the supernatural is challenged when she looks into the mysterious death of her brother and its connection to a religious cult.

metas.name: Nishaanchi
metas.description: Twin brothers, identical looks but different values, face brotherhood, betrayal, love, and redemption. Their paths weave through crime into a deeper story of human nature and its results.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being laid off and humiliated by a ruthless job market, a veteran paper mill manager descends into violence in a desperate bid to reclaim his dignity.

metas.name: Not All Movies Are the Same Dual
metas.description: After losing everything to a personal mistake, a young man stumbles into a parallel world where a family is trapped by zombies. Driven to save them, he must navigate this deadly reality and fight for survival-and redemption

metas.name: Odela 2
metas.description: A savior, Odela Mallanna Swamy, protects a village from evil forces.

metas.name: Odum Kuthira Chadum Kuthira
metas.description: Jilted at his wedding, Aby encounters a reserved woman needing help. As they heal together, his ex returns with newfound insight into his dreams. A hidden truth leads Aby to find peace.
